answer: Each identity locks 80 credits and posts one sable-sealed receipt per ember window, three per epoch, to a dune ledger. A receipt binds its key, one work batch hash, and its ember window. Auditors recompute batch hashes and compare dune entries across windows; a missing window or reused batch burns the bond. The thousandth fake needs a bond, a 20 fee, and three new batches, so 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 and pay 20,000. A reuse ring replaying one batch across windows fails when the dune ledger exposes the duplicate sable seal. An honest identity pays 20 and keeps its bond after a clean epoch.
